command: set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; cleanup(){ python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; echo '=== SILENT NATIVE DTMF 1 STATIC COORDS ==='; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100; OFF=0; for i in $(seq 1 50); do ST=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo ref_call_state=$ST; [ "$ST" = "2" ] && OFF=1 && break; sleep 0.4; done; test "$OFF" = "1"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8; sleep 6.0; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1)" = "2"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap 174 1826; sleep 0.45; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap 186 986; echo native_digit1_tapped=true; sleep 0.8; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1)" = "2"; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" capture 3000 /tmp/phase1c_ref.wav; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup; trap - EXIT; sleep 0.8; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1)" = "0"; test -s /tmp/phase1c_ref.wav; echo silent_reference_capture=true
